comments.body: The podman-image-trust 1 manpage was renamed.  We need to retain it, even if it is now very small and just points to these two new pages.
Rebased onto the latest main. Restored `podman-image-trust.1.md.in` as a parent manpage. Also updated the titles and NAME sections of the split manpages, which I missed in the original commit.
